visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark hair tied back, wearing a light blue ribbed tank top and dark gray skirt, stands in front of an open white closet. She holds a black box and a pair of white sneakers. (2) Close-up of white Adidas Tokyo sneakers with black stripes and cream laces sitting on a white surface. (3) The woman is shown in a full-body mirror shot, standing in her bedroom with a minimalist white closet and a beige bed behind her. (4) She holds up a long, white rectangular Michael Kors shoulder bag with a silver clasp, showcasing its texture and design. (5) Close-up shot as the woman opens the white bag to reveal a black wallet, a smartphone, and a white AirPods case tucked inside. (6) She holds a black box for a ghd hair straightener, pointing at the logo and smiling confidently at the camera. (7) Close-up of the ghd hair straightener, showing its sleek matte black finish and gold detailing. (8) The woman demonstrates using the hair straightener on her shoulder-length dark hair with light brown highlights. (9) She stands back in front of the camera, gesturing with her hands and inviting viewers to interact, set against the closet background.
